title: SIMPUL Parity Matrix (Cindy Orca Team & Orca CLI)

cindy.role: Primary architectural reference for Lead/Worker sessions, queues, steering, handoffs, and worktrees

orca_cli.role: Secondary inspiration for DAG, Pod, and CLI command structures; not a hard runtime dependency

status_definitions.CODE_PRESENT: Contract or logic present in codebase, but lacks dedicated automated unit or integration verification.
status_definitions.UNIT_TESTED: Verified by automated unit tests covering positive and negative logic branches.
status_definitions.INTEGRATED: Wired into end-to-end multi-component execution flow (e.g., Coordinator + Process + Queue + Store).
status_definitions.HOST_E2E_PASS: Proven through live, end-to-end execution on the actual host (Antigravity IDE / OS host).
status_definitions.BLOCKED: Hard security or architectural blocker preventing production certification (e.g. E18 OS sandbox, #22 WebAuthn).
status_definitions.NOT_ADOPTED: Intentionally excluded from scope with explicit rationale (e.g. desktop chat UI, mobile, remote SSH).

lead_worker_lifecycle_and_batch.name: Lead and Worker Role Separation
lead_worker_lifecycle_and_batch.target_behavior: Distinct roles and identities for supervisor (Lead/PM) and executor (Worker/Dev) processes.

upstream_reference.notes: Defines role separation in sessions schema (sessions.role = 'lead' | 'worker').

simpul_implementation.notes: Typed enum AgentRole.LEAD ('lead') and AgentRole.WORKER ('worker') with migration alias OrcaRole.

lead_worker_lifecycle_and_batch.security_boundary: Subprocess identity separation; intra-process role confusion denied.

lead_worker_lifecycle_and_batch.name: Worker Lifecycle State Machine
lead_worker_lifecycle_and_batch.target_behavior: Full worker lifecycle state machine: IDLE, RUNNING, PAUSED, INTERRUPTED, COMPLETED, FAILED, ARCHIVED.

upstream_reference.notes: Cindy defines 4 base states: 'idle', 'running', 'done', 'error'.

simpul_implementation.notes: Simpul extends Cindy's 4 states to 7 explicit lifecycle states with strict state transition validation.

lead_worker_lifecycle_and_batch.security_boundary: Interrupted or failed workers strictly rejected from submitting late completion handoffs.

lead_worker_lifecycle_and_batch.name: Batch Worker Creation and Provisioning
lead_worker_lifecycle_and_batch.target_behavior: Atomic registration and provisioning of multiple workers across specialized roles (PM, Dev, QA) for a team.

upstream_reference.notes: Cindy provisions worker slots during team initiation.

simpul_implementation.notes: Workers can be registered sequentially in Python; atomic batch creation API (PAR-05 / #48) is partially present in team manager.

lead_worker_lifecycle_and_batch.security_boundary: Per-worker working_dir validation and process isolation.
lead_worker_lifecycle_and_batch.missing_wiring: Batch creation MCP tool and atomic multi-worker batch API (Issue #48).

lead_worker_lifecycle_and_batch.name: Per-Worker Model and Budget Configuration
lead_worker_lifecycle_and_batch.target_behavior: Configurable model identifier, provider, harness, system prompt, and token budget per worker.

upstream_reference.notes: WorkerConfig in Cindy allows model and provider assignment per worker.

simpul_implementation.notes: WorkerConfig stores model, harness, provider, system_prompt, budget_tokens, tokens_consumed.

lead_worker_lifecycle_and_batch.security_boundary: Budget exhaustion causes fail-closed execution refusal; token counts persisted.

queue_and_steering.name: Durable Priority Queue
queue_and_steering.target_behavior: SQLite-persisted FIFO dispatch queue ordered by priority descending, creation ascending.

upstream_reference.notes: Durable tasks queue backed by database with priority sorting.

simpul_implementation.notes: SQLite simpul_queue table indexed by team_id, worker_session_id, priority, and created_at.

queue_and_steering.security_boundary: Cross-team dispatch denied; tasks bound to team_id.

queue_and_steering.name: Queue Deduplication and Idempotency
queue_and_steering.target_behavior: Idempotent task dispatch via dedup_key preventing duplicate task creation across retries.

upstream_reference.notes: Task idempotency and deduplication keys.

simpul_implementation.notes: Checks existing dispatch with dedup_key within team; returns existing QueueItem without duplication.

queue_and_steering.security_boundary: Duplicate execution prevention; atomic SQLite query.

queue_and_steering.name: In-Flight Task Steering
queue_and_steering.target_behavior: Supervisor injects steering instructions to active in-flight worker tasks without killing process.

upstream_reference.notes: Steering channel allows lead to adjust worker course.

simpul_implementation.notes: Appends typed steering instruction to queue item; authenticated against lead session identity.

queue_and_steering.security_boundary: Only lead of the owning team can steer; rogue or cross-team steering rejected with PermissionError.

queue_and_steering.name: Authenticated Inter-Agent Messaging
queue_and_steering.target_behavior: Point-to-point and broadcast messaging between Lead and Workers with cryptographic sender verification.

upstream_reference.notes: Message bus for inter-agent communication within a team.

simpul_implementation.notes: Persisted in simpul_messages table; verifies both sessions belong to the same team.

queue_and_steering.security_boundary: Cross-team message injection denied; sender impersonation rejected.

queue_and_steering.name: Evidence-Bound Handoff and Verification Receipt
queue_and_steering.target_behavior: Workers hand off completed work with cryptographic artifact hashes, exit codes, and QA verdicts.

upstream_reference.notes: Handoff mechanism returning results to lead.

simpul_implementation.notes: HandoffEvidence requires dispatch_id, from_worker_id, to_lead_id, status, artifacts, and metrics.

queue_and_steering.security_boundary: Spoofed handoffs from other workers or to wrong leads rejected; late completion on interrupted workers denied.

queue_and_steering.name: Task DAG, Pods, and Retry Semantics
queue_and_steering.target_behavior: Directed acyclic graph dependency resolution between tasks, pod isolation, and bounded retry count.

upstream_reference.notes: Orca CLI implements DAG dependency resolution and pod execution scheduling.

simpul_implementation.notes: Basic task dependency list exists in Run/Task domain contracts; full Pod DAG engine (PAR-10 / #53) remains in design/planning.

queue_and_steering.missing_wiring: Full Pod orchestration and bounded auto-retry state machine (Issue #53).

workspace_and_worktree.name: Isolated Git Worktree Lifecycle
workspace_and_worktree.target_behavior: Creation, tracking, and clean removal of dedicated Git worktrees per worker.

upstream_reference.notes: Git worktree isolation for parallel worker edits.

simpul_implementation.notes: Creates git worktree under .worktrees/<worker_id>, tracks in SQLite, and cleans up.

workspace_and_worktree.security_boundary: Dirty worktrees with uncommitted changes fail closed on deletion unless force specified.

workspace_and_worktree.name: Workspace Path Containment and Traversal Defense
workspace_and_worktree.target_behavior: Strict filesystem path validation preventing path traversal (..), symlink/junction breakout outside workspace.

upstream_reference.notes: Workspace scoping checks.

simpul_implementation.notes: Canonicalizes paths with resolve(); raises PermissionError on breakout.

workspace_and_worktree.security_boundary: Paths outside canonical workspace root strictly denied.

workspace_and_worktree.name: Branch Merge and Conflict Resolution
workspace_and_worktree.target_behavior: Safe merging of worker branch into target branch with conflict detection and rollback on failure.

upstream_reference.notes: Orca CLI worktree manager branch merge and cleanup.

simpul_implementation.notes: Worktree allocation and teardown implemented; automated 3-way merge and conflict queue (PAR-08 / #51) partially present.

workspace_and_worktree.security_boundary: No auto-push or direct push to protected main; manual or review-gated merge.
workspace_and_worktree.missing_wiring: Automated merge conflict adjudication and review queue integration (Issue #51).

resilience_and_recovery.name: Step-Indexed Worker Checkpointing
resilience_and_recovery.target_behavior: Periodic persisting of worker context snapshot, step index, tokens consumed, and state summary.

upstream_reference.notes: Worker checkpoints for session continuity.

simpul_implementation.notes: Persisted in simpul_checkpoints table; retrieves latest checkpoint by worker_id and step_index descending.

resilience_and_recovery.security_boundary: Checkpoint tampering detected by schema validation; worker cannot overwrite other workers' checkpoints.

resilience_and_recovery.name: Subprocess Crash Detection and Recovery
resilience_and_recovery.target_behavior: Reconciles OS process table against durable database on supervisor startup or crash injection.

upstream_reference.notes: Crash recovery and zombie worker cleanup.

simpul_implementation.notes: Marks dead processes FAILED, in-flight queue items FAILED, and respawns from checkpoint.

resilience_and_recovery.security_boundary: Dead workers prevented from completing tasks; zombie process trees terminated.

resilience_and_recovery.name: Ambiguous Side-Effect Quarantine
resilience_and_recovery.target_behavior: Tasks interrupted between external side effect and checkpoint transition to AMBIGUOUS and require human resolution.

upstream_reference.notes: Error handling on unexpected disconnection.

simpul_implementation.notes: Simpul extension status AMBIGUOUS; forbids automatic unverified re-execution.

resilience_and_recovery.security_boundary: No automatic replay of non-idempotent side effects without explicit operator decision.

resilience_and_recovery.name: Zero-Data-Loss SQLite Schema Migration
resilience_and_recovery.target_behavior: Safe migration of legacy orca_* schemas to native simpul_* tables with pre-backup and rollback.

upstream_reference.notes: Database schema initialization.

simpul_implementation.notes: Online SQLite backup, full column row verification, read-only backward compatible orca_* SQL views.

resilience_and_recovery.security_boundary: Rollback on migration error; legacy views are strictly read-only to prevent tampering.

host_integration_and_mcp.name: Antigravity IDE Stdio MCP Server
host_integration_and_mcp.target_behavior: Full MCP stdio protocol implementation with tool registration for Antigravity IDE agent panel.

upstream_reference.notes: MCP server interface for Orca team integration.

simpul_implementation.notes: MCP stdio server running via subagentbridge.server with absolute virtual environment python path.

host_integration_and_mcp.security_boundary: Privileged tools require human approval; raw code fix and approval tools unexposed to models.
host_integration_and_mcp.missing_wiring: Live IDE UI test in real packaged Antigravity build (Issue #45).

host_integration_and_mcp.name: Multi-Harness Capability Checking
host_integration_and_mcp.target_behavior: Truthful capability declaration across harnesses: native, antigravity, codex, claude_code, pi.

upstream_reference.notes: Harness selection in Cindy.

simpul_implementation.notes: Registry with fine-grained capabilities: local execution, tool calling, thinking budget, structured output.

host_integration_and_mcp.security_boundary: Declaring capability does not authorize unverified execution; unsupported harness raises KeyError.

host_integration_and_mcp.name: Safe Model-Callable Team Operations
host_integration_and_mcp.target_behavior: Safe MCP operations for team inspection, run readback, and evidence retrieval without policy escalation.

upstream_reference.notes: Orca MCP tool endpoints.

simpul_implementation.notes: Exposes inspection tools. approve_action and apply_code_fix are strictly locked down from model invocation.

host_integration_and_mcp.security_boundary: Approval and privileged mutations are not model-callable MCP tools.
host_integration_and_mcp.missing_wiring: Exposing native team/worker status inspection as safe MCP tools (Issue #54).

host_integration_and_mcp.name: Worker Progress Timeline and Status Observability
host_integration_and_mcp.target_behavior: Real-time timeline of worker events, log streaming, token usage, and active status inspection.

upstream_reference.notes: Team UI progress dashboard.

simpul_implementation.notes: Event and state storage present in database; comprehensive timeline aggregator (PAR-12 / #55) partially implemented.

host_integration_and_mcp.security_boundary: Read-only observability; no execution side effects.
host_integration_and_mcp.missing_wiring: Aggregated operator timeline view and streaming MCP endpoint (Issue #55).

security_boundaries.name: OS-Level Hostile Worker Isolation (E18)
security_boundaries.target_behavior: Hostile worker isolation via Windows AppContainer/Restricted Token or Linux dedicated UID/namespace.

upstream_reference.notes: Not present in upstream Cindy (Cindy runs workers under electron/host OS user).

simpul_implementation.notes: Linux dedicated UID exists as opt-in experimental control; Windows default remains same-user. E18 is strictly BLOCKED.

security_boundaries.security_boundary: Default remains same-user identity; AUTONOMY: OFF strictly enforced until true OS sandbox proven.
security_boundaries.missing_wiring: Windows AppContainer / restricted token or Linux namespace isolation verified on real hostile code (Issue #21).

security_boundaries.name: Independently Authenticated Human Operator Approval
security_boundaries.target_behavior: Out-of-band authenticated operator approval (WebAuthn / OIDC) independent of the agent and worker trust boundary.

upstream_reference.notes: UI prompt approval in electron app.

simpul_implementation.notes: Action-bound challenge-verifier exists in code/tests, but production WebAuthn/OIDC relying party (#22) is BLOCKED.

security_boundaries.security_boundary: In-process approval fixtures are NOT enterprise human authenticators. Issue #22 remains BLOCKED.
security_boundaries.missing_wiring: Independent WebAuthn/OIDC authentication server outside model-accessible MCP boundary (Issue #22).

security_boundaries.name: Cryptographic Execution Ticket Binding
security_boundaries.target_behavior: One-time execution tickets bound to worker_id, task_id, command, workspace, and expiry nonce.

upstream_reference.notes: Simpul security hardening design.

simpul_implementation.notes: HMAC-SHA256 signature binding exact context; single-use replay protection with CAS invalidation.

security_boundaries.security_boundary: Replayed tickets, modified commands, wrong tasks or expired tickets fail closed.

security_boundaries.name: Remote SSH and Device Link Workers
security_boundaries.target_behavior: Executing workers on remote hosts over SSH or mobile device linking.

upstream_reference.notes: Cindy Device Link and remote worker features.

simpul_implementation.notes: Not implemented in Simpul core. Requires explicit decision gate (PAR-17 / #60).

security_boundaries.security_boundary: Remote SSH execution introduces unbounded network attack surface.
security_boundaries.not_adopted_rationale: High enterprise attack surface and unauthorized credential propagation. Excluded from default scope under Issue #60 decision gate.

security_boundaries.name: Cindy Desktop App, Mobile, Browser Automation & Marketplace
security_boundaries.target_behavior: Consumer chat UI, mobile apps, browser DOM automation, periodic cron scheduling, and public plugin store.

upstream_reference.notes: Cindy Electron desktop app, browser extension, and marketplace integrations.

simpul_implementation.notes: Not implemented. Simpul is a headless MCP supervisor for Antigravity IDE, not an Electron desktop app.

security_boundaries.security_boundary: Browser and device automation present high risk of unauthorized data exfiltration.
security_boundaries.not_adopted_rationale: Simpul explicitly positions Google Antigravity IDE as the primary frontend. Building a standalone desktop/mobile app or plugin store is out of product scope under Issue #61 decision gate.
